topic: How do satellite antenna feed spacing and propagation path length constraints affect power consumption in LOS environments?
response: In LOS (Line-of-Sight) environments, satellite antenna feed spacing constraints do not directly affect power consumption. However, propagation path length constraints can impact power consumption due to increased signal attenuation with distance. The wavelength of the carrier frequency (𝜆c = c0/fc) determines the minimum required antenna size and spacing to maintain a clear LOS. As the distance between the satellite and user increases, more powerful transmitters are needed to compensate for signal loss.
